nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Blemish Breakthrough Stick It to Zits Pimple Patches

segments.combination: The one reviewer who names combination skin found the patches stuck well even in spots where patches usually struggle to adhere on her, though the pimple only cleared about a day or two faster than usual, not dramatically.
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who describes acne-prone, sensitive skin calls this a must-have and even wears it under makeup as a spot concealer, without mentioning any irritation.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report pimples visibly flattened, drained of gunk, and less noticeable within one to two days, often overnight; several disagree, saying the patches did not work as well as other brands, made no visible difference for them, worked more slowly than hoped, or only partly flattened the blemish rather than resolving it.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report reduced redness around the blemish, often visible by the next morning or by the end of a workday; no reviewer reports redness getting worse.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer credits the patches with absorbing oil from the blemish as part of the healing process; this is the only report framed around oil control specifically.
concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers note the patches reduce breakouts without drying out the surrounding skin, though this is mentioned only in passing rather than as a main focus.

aspects.libelle: Great value for the price and count
Only sold in one patch size
Gentle enough for a child's skin

extraits.texte: Adhesion could definitely be better with these! But it did its job with oil absorption and healing. Would I repurchase these on my own? Probably not, but they are good for somebody on a budget and I really like the packaging

Very compact to bring with you inside your purse! My problem with this is it didn't really work well with me and I didn't see a difference. It sticks on your face and removes fairly easy! But I do not think this product works great for my skin type.

extraits.titre: Sticks great to combination type skin
extraits.texte: I break out a pretty decent amount and I have combination skin so sometimes I have trouble getting the acne patches to stick to some areas of my skin but these stayed on really well, for hours at a time. I didn't notice a sent to these which is fine because I don't mind using unscented products. I didn't really notice a huge difference in the acne after using these, they didn't seem like they really dried out but it did seem like the pimple went away a day or two faster than it normally would so these would be good for purchasing occasionally but maybe not on a regular basis

extraits.titre: A must have emergency acne patch
extraits.texte: I praise anything that suits my skin cause having a acne prone sensitive skin or not easy. This product from elf is yet another must have for me. I apply on top of my makeup too it works as a concealer path over my acne.

These are definitely not my favorite acne patches, but they absolutely do the job! They're invisible on the skin and help reduce the size of my acne. I leave these at my work desk in case I start picking at a newly formed pimple. I take them off at the end of the day and can notice the difference in redness and size.

These patches are super easy to use and actually stay on overnight. I like that they help reduce the appearance of breakouts without drying my skin out too much. They're thin enough to blend into the skin better than a lot of other acne patches, I've tried, and they make blemishes look less irritated by the morning. Such a great affordable option to keep on hand for unexpected breakouts!
